attribution: AEOTester (https://aeotester.com). Reuse requires attribution - see LICENSE-RUBRIC.

scoring.check_status: Each check returns pass | warning | fail | na and a score between 0 and its weight.
scoring.conditional: A check with conditional: true may return na (not applicable). Its weight is then removed from the denominator, so a plain content site is scored out of max_score minus that weight.
scoring.unreachable: A check never scores a site down for a resource it could not read (network error, 401/403/429/503, timeout). It returns warning at roughly half weight with inconclusive: true.
scoring.percentage: round(total_score / available_points * 100), where available_points = max_score minus the weight of na checks.
scoring.advisory: A check with advisory: true is reported as advice and never scored. Its weight is left out of max_score and the category max.
scoring.excluded_pages: Pages kept out of search on purpose (noindex for all crawlers, not the homepage, not in the sitemap, more than one page audited) are left out of every page check average. Their freshness and author attribution findings are reported as advice. If every page would be excluded, none is.
scoring.advice: Checks may report advice: findings worth knowing that cost no points.

static-html.detect: HTML files in the repo root, public/, dist/ or site/ with no framework config

hugo.detect: hugo.toml, hugo.yaml, config.toml with Hugo keys, or a layouts/ + content/ pair

vite-spa.detect: vite.config.* with a root index.html; crawlability warnings apply

wordpress.detect: wp-config.php, wp-content/ or a theme/plugin repo

other-cms.detect: content stored outside the repo (database-backed CMS)

categories.name: AI crawler access
categories.description: Whether AI crawlers are allowed in and told how they may use the content.

categories.name: Crawlability and indexing
categories.description: Whether the page can be found, fetched and indexed at all.

categories.name: Structured data
categories.description: JSON-LD schema that lets AI engines extract facts reliably.

categories.name: Meta and social tags
categories.description: Title, description, social cards, language and viewport.

categories.name: Content structure and quality
categories.description: Headings, depth, freshness, authorship, alt text, linking and accessibility.

categories.name: Agent readiness
categories.description: Whether an AI agent (not just a search engine) can read and act on the page.
